government.note: A self-declared, internationally unrecognised republic in Donetsk Oblast from 7 April 2014; Russia recognised it on 21 February 2022 and announced its annexation on 30 September 2022. The 'constitution' flags are rough approximations.

title.en: Head of the Donetsk People's Republic

holders.vacant_reason: The Donetsk People's Republic was declared on 7 April 2014; it did not exist before.
Who led the republic before the first prime minister took office on 16 May 2014 is not recorded here.

holders.note: Chairman of the Council of Ministers (Wikidata).
Chairman of the Council of Ministers from 7 August 2014, Head from 4 November 2014 (Wikidata); until 31 August 2018.

holders.vacant_reason: Interim arrangements between 31 August and 7 September 2018 are not recorded here.

holders.note: Head from 7 September 2018 (Wikidata, confirmed 20 November 2018); continues as Head of the Donetsk People's Republic as a region of Russia after the annexation of 30 September 2022.

offices.review_note: Wikidata confirms the Borodai, Zakharchenko and Pushilin terms. Who led the republic from 7 April to 16 May 2014 and from 31 August to 7 September 2018 is not recorded; the Borodai start date is for the prime minister post. Check the Wikipedia DPR article.

start_2000.ideology_support_note: Gameplay judgement; the entity did not exist in 2000, so this is the base it would have on appearing.

claims.note: The republic claimed the whole of Donetsk Oblast as it stood within Ukraine.
